units.source_text: 岛村这次逗留时间这么长，好像忘记了要回到家中妻子的身边似的。

en.t: Shimamura stayed so long this time that it seemed he had forgotten he was supposed to return home to his wife.

units.source_text: 这倒不是离不开这个地方，或者同她难舍难分，而是由于长期以来自然形成了习惯于等候驹子频频前来相会。

en.t: It was not that he could not leave the place, or that parting from her was unbearable, but that over time he had naturally fallen into the habit of waiting for Komako to come and see him again and again.

units.source_text: 而且驹子越是寂寞难过，岛村对自己的苛责也就越是严厉，仿佛自己不复存在了。

en.t: And the lonelier and more distressed Komako became, the more severely Shimamura reproached himself, as if he himself no longer existed.

units.source_text: 这就是说，他明知自己寂寞，却仅仅一动不动地呆在那里。

en.t: In other words, though he knew he was lonely, he merely stayed there without moving.

units.source_text: 驹子为什么闯进自己的生活中来呢？岛村是难以解释的。

en.t: Why had Komako burst into his life? Shimamura found it hard to explain.

units.source_text: 岛村了解驹子的一切，可是驹子却似乎一点也不了解岛村。

en.t: Shimamura understood everything about Komako, yet Komako seemed not to understand Shimamura at all.

units.source_text: 驹子撞击墙壁的空虚回声，岛村听起来有如雪花飘落在自己的心田里。

en.t: To Shimamura, the hollow echo of Komako striking against a wall sounded like snowflakes falling into the fields of his own heart.

units.source_text: 当然，岛村也不可能永远这样放荡不羁。

en.t: Of course, Shimamura could not go on living so recklessly forever.
